title: #220 Online Meeting

modelPlan.focus: Evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of online business meetings, focusing on efficiency, accessibility, and potential drawbacks like reduced communication quality.
outline: body1: Advantages of online meetings (convenience, cost-saving, wider participation)
body2: Disadvantages of online meetings (poor communication, technical issues, lack of face-to-face interaction)
keyArguments: Online meetings enhance efficiency and accessibility by eliminating the need for physical presence and reducing costs.
However, they can lead to challenges such as diminished non-verbal cues and potential technical disruptions, affecting communication quality.
